purpose: Behavioral integration of the M402/M443 battle-destruction LP recovery adapters with the M403/M446 Fire Princess LP-gain adapter in TagDuel 2v2.

upstream.battleRecovery: M402/M443 — Absorbing Kid from the Sky and Guardian Angel Joan
upstream.pipelineReference: M448 — Solemn Wishes to Fire Princess

cards.name: Fire Princess
cards.sourceEvidence: M403 official card evidence; not newly admitted or certified

contract: A trusted battle-destruction event is resolved against the physical inventory and actual destination.
Battle LP recovery is committed to the source controller team's shared LP.
Fire Princess consumes the positive LP-gain event after the gain commit.
Fire Princess damage is committed separately to the opposing team's shared LP.
Physical owner seats remain distinct from current controller teams.
Battle and LP-gain idempotency ledgers are independent, even when they share an event ID.

groups: Absorbing Kid Level-based recovery to Fire Princess
Guardian Angel Joan original-ATK recovery to Fire Princess
controller-team routing versus physical owner seat
separate battle and LP ledgers with replay safety

limitations: This verifies the adapter-to-adapter event contract, not registration in the central resolver.
The trusted battle resolver must provide the committed battle event; this test simulates the caller's atomic LP commits.
No live Discord gateway or production database was exercised.
